name: Welcome Back Portland 2022
information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WelcomeBackPortland2022#17276-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Please also be sure to review the [Health and Safety](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WelcomeBackPortland2022#17432-health-and-safety) tab to check additional COVID-19 requirements for this competition.

**Join our facebook group to hear about competitions in the Pacific Northwest before they're announced and keep in touch with cubers in the area!**
